source: Direct read of Search Console Links report in the user's existing browser tab
limitations: This report is not a complete live backlink census and does not establish that no links exist anywhere on the web.
The UI did not expose a report update date in the read view; no date was inferred.
Internal-link counts are Google's reported sample/aggregation, not the repository's complete static graph or proof that absent pages are orphaned.
No domains, anchors or backlinks were invented; no disavow/removal request, contact or directory submission was made.
